topic: How to Wash Linen Without Shrinking It
notes: Make the care label the primary instruction because linen garments can differ in finish, construction and blend. Use gentle, lower-temperature washing and avoid unsupported high-heat drying advice. Explain that excessive heat can alter linen and may contribute to shrinkage. Do not present one universal temperature for every linen item.
